title: Don't Let Dad See This
trend: TikTok 'Don't let a fanatic see this' (show a niche product with on-screen text warning that a fanatic or mom must not see it; Rising, top 2.7M, Virlo TikTok trends updated Nov 26 2026, US) + Black Friday hauls and the first weekend of holiday lights — siblings hide Dad's light-show kit from the biggest holiday lights dad on the street
youtube_title: We bought Dad a light show for Christmas. Now we have to hide it from him for a month 💡
description:
Ava and Jonah found the perfect gift for their dad: a light kit that makes the whole house blink to music. Now they have to hide it from the biggest holiday lights dad on the street. The pumpkin still on the porch is not helping.

#cartoon #animation #funny #christmaslights #shorts
tiktok_caption: do not let a holiday lights dad see this 💡 #cartoon #animation #funny #christmaslights

lines.text: Jonah. We got it. The light kit that makes the whole house blink to music.
Do not say that out loud. If Dad hears the word blink, he will come out of the walls.
I am the pumpkin from Halloween. It is the end of November. Nobody has moved me. I have seen a lot.
We hide it for one month. Then on Christmas morning, boom. Best gift ever.
One month? Dad can smell a new extension cord from across town.
It is true. Last year he found a string of lights inside a lasagna.
Okay. Hiding spot one. Behind the pumpkin.
Absolutely not. I am soft now. Things go into me and they do not come out.
Kids. Why is the porch so quiet?
Hi, Dad. No reason. Nice hat.
I wear it to sleep. In case a bulb goes out at night.
How would you even know?
I feel it. In my knees. Bulb number four hundred and twelve on the gutter is flickering. Excuse me.
He went up the ladder in socks. He has done this since October. I respect him. I fear him.
Hiding spot two. The freezer. Under the peas.
Nobody has touched the peas since two thousand twenty one. It is perfect.
Who moved the peas?
How? How does he know?
The freezer light was on one second longer. I time my freezer.
Let the record show the man times his freezer.
Plan three. We give it to Mrs. Delgado next door.
Mrs. Delgado sleeps with a pillow on her face because of our lights. She will never open that box.
Kids. Sit down. On the step. We need to talk.
Dad, we can explain. It is a box. Of nothing. Empty box.
I know about the light kit. I saw it on the doorbell camera. The doorbell camera is also lights.
So the gift is ruined.
No. Because I bought the exact same kit. This morning. At four. For you two.
For us? Why?
Twenty one years on that roof. My knees have their own weather. I am passing on the ladder.
The ladder. He is passing on the ladder. I need a moment.
So we do the lights now? Both kits?
Both kits. The whole street. Music on the hour. Plug it into the garage, not the toaster.
Dad. We will make you proud.
I know. Now I am going inside. To sit. Like a normal person.
He will be back on the roof by Tuesday.
One more thing. Can the pumpkin be in the show?
Me? A job? In December?
We put one light inside you. You glow on the big note.
I have been waiting a month for someone to say that. I am going to cry seeds.
From in here, I can see the gutter. Bulb four hundred and twelve is still flickering.
Dad. Sit down.
I am sitting. On the ladder.
Tuesday was generous.
